messages.author: f8c324e17a05bd73
messages.subject: Shiny Server Pro - Technical Support
parts:
Hi,

We have just started using a few shiny apps running on Shiny Server (open source) in our organisation.

However, the IT team has asked me to get some contact information in case if we need any technical assistance with regards to shiny-server.
Being an open source, we do not have presently one.

My Question:
I need to understand, if we buy a Shiny Server Pro - will we get any technical support in case required from Rstudio team. 
An in person contact that can help us to resolve the technical issue either via phone or through remote or any other way.

As an example, the IT team faced challenges to change the default port to 80 from 3838. If we had some contact we could have resolved it easily. We are ready to shell some money if needed.

Note: No doubt the community is awesome, but as an organisation, we need some technical know how person/support whom we can rely on.

Regards,
Vasim
Mumbai, India

messages.author: 81263ada33bc2f91
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server Pro - Technical Support
parts:
Vasim,

Premium email support is available for customers of Shiny Server Pro.  When you buy a license, we send you a link to the support interface.  Questions from open source Shiny Server users will be answered here on this forum.

For your current issue, you can change the value of the port on the `listen` directive for your server, e.g.,
`listen 80;` instead of the default `listen 3838;` value.

Best,
Amanda
